newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Tax payments keep Hungarian O/N rates firm.
newsitem.headline: Tax payments keep Hungarian O/N rates firm.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed above Monday's levels as yesterday's tax payments left their impact on the market, dealers said.
Overnight rates finished at 26.50 percent, above the opening levels of 25 percent and also above Monday's close of 24.50 percent, but below the day's peak of 27 percent.
"I think yesterday's tax payments may have meant a relatively substantial burden for all banks," said Karoly Barath of Postabank.
"The impact of tax payments may last for another one day or two."
Another dealer earlier today and Barath also said that tight liquidity has characterised the market recently.
"Banks' lending activity may have increased," Barath said, adding this might have resulted in narrow supply.
